g.title: dataflow
g.text: IMG-OPT-03 PSF quality: data flow of the result fields (ANALYSIS)
solid blue = stage writes the field, dashed grey = stage reads it; italic = property (derived)

a.xlink:title: Run the IMG-OPT-03 Strehl analysis for each data state.

Load a FITS file with a grid of PSFs, resolve the mask-dependent observing config, and find the 1st-pass centroids of the PSFs.
INPUTS ---------- file_name_abs : str Path to the FITS file containing the PSF grid to analyze. fp_mask : str Focal-plane mask label (sets the LM/N band). pp_mask : str Pupil-plane mask label (sets the reference aperture geometry). filter_name : str, optional Name of the observing filter associated with the PSF grid. psfs_subset : str or int, optional Either ``"all"`` to process the full grid or an integer giving how many PSFs from the start of the centroid list to process. config_coords_guesses_file_name_abs : str, optional Path to the configuration file containing initial coordinate guesses. config_observing : dict, optional Observing configuration dictionary. oversample_factor : int, optional Oversampling factor for centroiding and fitting (keep odd to facilitate centering).
OUTPUTS ------- PsfGrid The frame, the resolved observing config, the 1st-pass centroids and PSF counts; input to cutout_psf / process_one_psf, collect_strehls and plot_strehl_fov.

Native-sampling square cutout of PSF num_coord, around the closest ints to its 1st-pass centroid (input to process_one_psf).
INPUTS ---------- psf_grid : PsfGrid From prepare_psf_grid. num_coord : int Zero-based index of the PSF.
OUTPUTS ------- np.ndarray Cutout of side psf_grid.edge_size_original (native pixels).

Gather the per-PSF fit results (in the order of the 1st-pass centroids) into one result for the file.
INPUTS ---------- psf_grid : PsfGrid From prepare_psf_grid. fit_results : list[SinglePsfFitResult] From process_one_psf, one per PSF processed (index = num_coord).
OUTPUTS ------- StrehlRunResult Per-PSF Strehl estimates (+ 1st-pass centroids) and PSF counts; verdicts still empty (see the requirement checks and log_test_outcome).

FYI plots on the detector frame: the Strehl of each PSF, and the Strehl from all methods for one randomly chosen PSF.
INPUTS ---------- run_result : StrehlRunResult From collect_strehls. grid_data : np.ndarray The detector frame (native pixel scale), e.g. PsfGrid.grid_data. results_write_dir : str Directory where the plots are saved.
OUTPUTS ------- None Saves the plots.

Decide METIS-1408 (Strehl >= 80% at lambda > 3 um in all modes over the entire FOV) and METIS-1409 (Strehl > 0.8 at 3 um for IMG-LM and -NQ over the full FOV): every PSF has Strehl (criterion_key) >= strehl_min (see _strehl_verdict for FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE / NOT EVALUATED).
INPUTS: - run_result (StrehlRunResult): from collect_strehls - criterion_key (str): Strehl estimator used for pass/fail - strehl_min (float): minimum Strehl ratio
OUTPUTS: - run_result (StrehlRunResult), with verdicts['METIS-1408'] and verdicts['METIS-1409'] set

Decide METIS-2864 (minimum Strehl of the WCU+CFO+IMG-LM optical path > 80% at 3.3 um over the entire FOV): the same Strehl criterion as metis_1408_1409_check, for LM data only; N/A for N-band data.
INPUTS: - run_result (StrehlRunResult): from collect_strehls - criterion_key (str): Strehl estimator used for pass/fail - strehl_min (float): minimum Strehl ratio
OUTPUTS: - run_result (StrehlRunResult), with verdicts['METIS-2864'] set

Decide METIS-3503 (the shape of the instrument PSF can be characterised across the entire FoV using the WCU): PASS if every PSF in the grid was analysed and has a finite Strehl estimate (criterion_key); FAIL if any analysed PSF has a non-finite one; INCONCLUSIVE if only a subset of the grid was analysed; NOT EVALUATED if criterion_key is missing for some PSF.
INPUTS: - run_result (StrehlRunResult): from collect_strehls - criterion_key (str): Strehl estimator whose fit must have succeeded
OUTPUTS: - run_result (StrehlRunResult), with verdicts['METIS-3503'] set

Log the outcome of each IMG-OPT-03 requirement (as decided by metis_1408_1409_check, metis_2864_check and metis_3503_check) and of the whole test: PASS if all applicable requirements pass; FAIL if any fails; else INCONCLUSIVE.
INPUTS: - run_result (StrehlRunResult): with verdicts set by the requirement checks
OUTPUTS: - run_result (StrehlRunResult), with verdict_overall set
